value.rationale: Explicit full mean-time operator resolves phase-dependent transport as well as every injection site, not merely a routine special case of an endpoint time. It gives a natural exact physical design rule: for fixed injection m>=2, optimal sink coupling is independent of how many additional sites the coherent excitation may explore. The known endpoint formula alone cannot determine this for interior sites or coherent superpositions; this is experimentally relevant to site-selective excitation and dissipation engineering.
